decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A.01 Revision 02, A.02 Revision 02, A.03 Revision 02, A.04 Revision 02, A.05 Revision 02, A.06 Revision 02 received on 04/03/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - Within one month of the date of this permission samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the dwelling hereby permitted shall be submitted to the local planning authority for approval. The materials shall not be used until written approval has been received and the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 3 - Within one month of the date of this permission full details of both hard and soft landscape shall be submitted to the local planning authority for approval. These works shall not be carried out untill written approval is received and shall be in accordance with the approved details. These details shall include means of enclosure; vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material and refuse storage. Soft landscape works shall include planting plans; schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows [other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be constructed.

Condition : 5 - The window formed in the side elevation between ground and first floor level. serving the staircase, shall be a fixed pane and obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 8 - Within one month of the date of this permission proof must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority that the additional window in the rear of the original property at no. 32 Riverdale Road, as shown on the originally approved plans (reference 12/002, Unnumbered plans received 22/11/2013), has been provided.has been provided.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow two projecting windows at first rear and additional windows on east side elevation of planning permission 00945/32/P7 dated 03/12/2013 for the erection of a two storey detached house adjacent to 32 Riverdale Road
